stem: Two rooms use different root-zone media but the same irrigation schedule. One medium retains more water and drains more slowly. What is the best interpretation?
choices: The media may require different irrigation management because water retention, air-filled porosity, drainage, structure, and container context affect root-zone behavior.
The same irrigation schedule must be correct because the crop cultivar is the same.
Media physical properties matter only during transplanting.
Water retention can be ignored if nutrient concentration is unchanged.
rationale: Media properties determine how water and air are held and released; identical schedules can produce different root-zone conditions in different media.
